policy: Exact individual identities; resolved Johnson V only; empirical mass/radius and Stefan-Boltzmann luminosity explicitly distinguished from direct measurements. Preserve unrelated quantities, source errors and astrometry. No age inferred.

recons.name: RECONS 100 nearest star systems, GJ 412 A/B individual rows
recons.caveat: Compiled individual V magnitudes; no per-star uncertainty or observing epoch supplied. Do not adopt the old table parallaxes, absolute magnitudes, masses or classifications.

burt2014.name: Burt et al. 2014, Table 1 and section 2
burt2014.caveat: V attributed to Rojas-Ayala et al. 2012; mass attributed to Boyajian et al. 2012 and the Henry & McCarthy empirical calibration. Not a dynamical mass.

lindgren2017.name: Lindgren & Heiter 2017, Tables 1-3 and 5, sections 3.2.2 and 4.2
lindgren2017.caveat: Mass from Benedict et al. 2016 Ks calibration; radius from Mann et al. 2015 Eq. 4. Table 3 gives no individual errors. Ks has a large error; these are empirical estimates at the source parallax, not interferometric/dynamical measurements. Temperature is the SME spectral fit in Table 5, not the rejected color calibration. The paper varies temperature by 100 K for abundance sensitivity; this is not adopted as an individual temperature error.
